description: The govulncheck CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job 'govulncheck') scans the core module (GOWORK=off, ./...) and adapters/pgx, but the third Go module adapters/otel (module github.com/JLugagne/egauth/adapters/otel, with direct third-party dependencies go.opentelemetry.io/otel, otel/sdk, otel/trace v1.46.0) has no govulncheck step: the test-adapters-otel job runs only go vet + go test. A known CVE in the OpenTelemetry SDK (or its transitive deps) would therefore not fail CI. Static proof, no PoC test applicable to a pure workflow-coverage gap (poc_test_path null).
remediation: Add a govulncheck step for the otel module mirroring the pgx pattern (working-directory: adapters/otel, `go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.1.4 ./...`), or run govulncheck once per module in a matrix over the three module roots.
title: govulncheck does not cover the adapters/otel module
